mxCell.value: <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:#0F172A;">Attorney.AI — Complete Lawyer Matching, Consultation & Hire Journey</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#64748B;margin-top:3px;">Comprehensive 6-Stage Architecture: AI Vector Matching → Availability Subtraction → Idempotent Booking → Lawyer Decision Triage → Live Daily.co Session → Case Hire</div>
STAGE 1: AI CASE MATCHING
STAGE 2: SLOT AVAILABILITY ENGINE
STAGE 3: IDEMPOTENT BOOKING HOLD
STAGE 4: LAWYER TRIAGE & BRANCHING
STAGE 5: LIVE VIDEO SESSION (DAILY.CO)
STAGE 6: OUTCOME & HIRE UNLOCK

<b style="color:#0284C7;font-size:12px;">Client: Directory & Matching</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#334155;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Browse Directory (/lawyers, 20/page)<br/>• 7 Practice Area chips + Province filter<br/>• <b>AI Match trigger</b>: ?case_id=... (from Intake)<br/>• Fallback: "Describe problem" Roman Urdu box</div>

<span style="background:#E0F2FE;color:#0369A1;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">GET</span> <b>/api/v1/lawyers</b> (filters, q, sort)<br/><span style="background:#E0F2FE;color:#0369A1;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">GET</span> <b>/api/v1/lawyers/counts</b> (chips count)<br/><span style="background:#EDE9FE;color:#6D28D9;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">GET</span> <b>/lawyers/match/{case_id}</b> (AI match)

<b>lawyer_service.py (Matching Engine)</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Refuses draft cases (422 case_draft)<br/>• Queries <b>lawyer_embeddings</b> vector pool<br/>• Merges province, specialization & rating<br/>• Returns top 5 with match_score & reason</div>

<b>ChromaDB Vector Retrieval</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#64748B;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Embeds bio, practice areas, experience<br/>• Real semantic similarity cosine scoring<br/>• Drops stale vectors / unapproved KYC</div>

<b style="color:#0369A1;">MongoDB: users</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">• role: lawyer, kyc_verified: true<br/>• lawyer_profile (bar_number, hourly_rate)<br/>• Exact geocoded office coordinates (lat/lng)</div>

<b style="color:#0D9488;font-size:12px;">Booking Modal: Date & Slot Pick</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#334155;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Opens with lawyer consultation fee (PKR)<br/>• Date picker scans <b>14 days earliest open hint</b><br/>• Displays only real bookable 60-min slots</div>

<span style="background:#CCFBF1;color:#0F766E;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">GET</span> <b>/lawyers/{id}/bookable-slots</b><br/><span style="background:#E0F2FE;color:#0369A1;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">GET</span> <b>/lawyers/{id}/availability</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#64748B;margin-top:4px;">Params: from, to, duration_minutes=60 (PKT tz)</div>

<b>Slot Subtraction Math Engine</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;"><b>Working Hours (from availability config)</b><br/>− Exception days (leaves / court holidays)<br/>− Active pending / confirmed appointments<br/>− <b>Court Hearings</b>: holds 3 hrs (or full day)<br/>− Lawyer diary entries & past timestamps</div>

<b style="color:#0F766E;">MongoDB: lawyer_availability</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">• _id: lawyer_id<br/>• working_hours (mon..sun start/end)<br/>• unavailable_dates & exception reasons</div>

<b style="color:#D97706;font-size:12px;">Submit Consultation Request</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#334155;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Choose Mode: <b>Video call</b> or <b>In person</b><br/>• Link confirmed Case ID (notes ≤ 1,000 chars)<br/>• Generates unique <b>idempotency key</b></div>

<span style="background:#FEF3C7;color:#B45309;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">POST</span> <b>/api/v1/appointments</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#64748B;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">• Headers: Idempotency-Key<br/>• Body: {lawyer_id, scheduled_at, mode, case_id}<br/>• Rejects double-click (409 conflict if slot taken)</div>

<b>appointment_service.book_appointment</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Validates future :00/:30 UTC offset<br/>• Verifies client case ownership (blocks draft)<br/>• Enforces lawyer KYC approval & active status<br/>• Atomically holds timeslot for both parties<br/>• Dispatches WebSocket notification to lawyer</div>

<b>Status: PENDING</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#B45309;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.3;">• Client can reschedule or cancel request<br/>• Client can attach up to 5 case files<br/>• Private thread locked until lawyer confirms</div>

<b style="color:#D97706;">MongoDB: appointments</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">• status: <b>pending</b><br/>• Unique index on (lawyer_id, scheduled_at)<br/>• Unique index on (client_id, scheduled_at)</div>

<b style="color:#7C3AED;font-size:12px;">Lawyer Dashboard & Decision Triage</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#334155;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Lawyer views pending consultation in /lawyer<br/>• Reviews client story, case type & documents<br/>• Three distinct decision actions available</div>

<span style="background:#EDE9FE;color:#6D28D9;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">PATCH</span> <b>/appointments/{id}/accept</b> (Daily/link)<br/><span style="background:#FEE2E2;color:#991B1B;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">PATCH</span> <b>/appointments/{id}/decline</b><br/><span style="background:#E0F2FE;color:#0369A1;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">POST</span> <b>/appointments/{id}/propose-reschedule</b>

<b style="color:#059669;">[PATH A] ACCEPT ➔ CONFIRMED</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#334155;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.3;">• Creates <b>Daily.co video room</b> token<br/>• Generates <b>.ics</b> calendar invite download<br/>• Unlocks private in-app messaging thread</div>

<b style="color:#DC2626;">[PATH B] DECLINE ➔ CANCELLED</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#334155;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.3;">• status: cancelled, cancelled_by: lawyer<br/>• Slot freed up immediately in calendar<br/>• Client receives instant lawyer re-match tips</div>

<b style="color:#D97706;">[PATH C] PROPOSE NEW TIME</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#334155;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.3;">• Lawyer suggests up to 3 alternate slots<br/>• Client selects slot ➔ updates scheduled_at<br/>• Old slot held until client responds</div>

<b style="color:#7C3AED;">Status Transitions in DB</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">• <b>confirmed</b>: meeting room generated<br/>• Cancellation locked inside 2h of start<br/>• Notifications broadcasted over WebSocket</div>

<b style="color:#DB2777;font-size:12px;">Active Consultation Experience</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#334155;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Countdown timer ("Starts in 10 mins")<br/>• Pre-join hardware check (Mic/Camera test)<br/>• 60-min in-app WebRTC video room</div>

<span style="background:#FCE7F3;color:#BE185D;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">GET</span> <b>/appointments/{id}/video-token</b><br/><span style="background:#E0F2FE;color:#0369A1;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">POST</span> <b>/appointments/{id}/messages</b><br/><span style="background:#EDE9FE;color:#6D28D9;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">WS</span> <b>/ws/chat (appointment thread)</b>

<b>WebRTC Video & Chat Engine</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Daily.co server integration (or external meeting link)<br/>• Ephemeral tokens minted with appointment expiry<br/>• Document previewing during active call<br/>• Auto-transitions to <b>ended</b> after 60 mins</div>

<b style="color:#DB2777;">Media & Message Storage</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">• appointment_messages collection<br/>• Daily.co session log & duration record<br/>• status: <b>confirmed ➔ ended</b></div>

<b style="color:#059669;font-size:12px;">Outcome & Critical Next Steps</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#334155;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Lawyer marks: <b>Completed</b> or <b>No-Show</b><br/>• Records consultation outcome & next advice<br/>• Unlocks client: <b>Hire Lawyer</b> & <b>Review</b></div>

<span style="background:#DCFCE7;color:#15803D;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">POST</span> <b>/appointments/{id}/outcome</b><br/><span style="background:#FEF3C7;color:#B45309;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">POST</span> <b>/lawyers/{id}/review</b> (1-5 stars)<br/><span style="background:#DCFCE7;color:#15803D;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;">POST</span> <b>/engagements/hire</b> (Doc 15)

<b>Post-Consultation & Hire Engine</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;">• Sets appointment status = <b>completed</b><br/>• <b>review-eligibility</b> becomes true<br/>• Recalculates lawyer public rating<br/>• <b>GATEWAY</b>: Completed consultation is mandatory prerequisite to send Hire Request</div>

<b style="color:#059669;">Unlocks Next Journey Steps</b><br/><div style="font-size:10px;color:#334155;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5;">➔ <b>Hire Lawyer (Doc 15)</b>: Fee proposal<br/>➔ <b>Case Opened (Doc 16)</b>: Formal Case<br/>➔ <b>Public Review</b>: Directory rating updated</div>

<b style="color:#059669;">MongoDB: reviews & cases</b><br/><div style="font-size:9px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">• reviews: stars, feedback, client_id<br/>• lawyer_profile.rating updated<br/>• engagements & case retainer unlocked</div>
